summary: Iteration 34 - Tested 'Pay First, Then Login' guest payment flow. All backend guest payment endpoints working correctly. Frontend pricing section displays correctly with billing toggle. Razorpay checkout opens successfully for guest users.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/payment/guest/create-order creates orders for all plan types (starter, growth, enterprise)
Backend: /api/payment/guest/create-order handles monthly and yearly billing cycles
Backend: /api/payment/guest/verify endpoint exists and validates signatures
Backend: /api/payment/activate-pending returns success=false when no pending payment
Frontend: Login button visible in navbar for non-logged users
Frontend: Pricing section displays all three plans (Starter, Growth, Enterprise)
Frontend: Billing toggle switches between Monthly and Yearly
Frontend: Savings badges shown for yearly plans (Save ₹1,200, ₹2,400, ₹6,000)
Frontend: Payment buttons show correct amounts based on billing cycle
Frontend: Clicking payment button opens Razorpay checkout modal (guest flow)
Frontend: Razorpay modal shows correct price (₹499 for Starter monthly)

test_credentials.demo_mode: Click 'Try A Demo' button to access demo dashboard

seed_data_creation: Created temporary test user for authenticated endpoint testing (cleaned up after tests)

mocked_apis_list: Monthly subscriptions use one-time orders (not true Razorpay recurring subscriptions due to 'fee bearer' setting limitation)
mocked_apis.note: Guest payment endpoints are real Razorpay integration. Actual payment completion cannot be automated due to 3rd party checkout.

guest_create_order_endpoint.details: Creates Razorpay orders without authentication. Returns order_id, guest_id, amount, key_id, description.

guest_verify_endpoint.details: Verifies Razorpay payment signature and stores pending activation. Returns success with redirect_to_login flag.

activate_pending_endpoint.details: Requires authentication. Links pending payment to user account and activates plan.

details.billing_toggle: Working - switches between monthly and yearly views

payment_buttons.details: Payment buttons visible and functional. Opens Razorpay checkout for guest users.

login_button.details: Visible in navbar for non-logged users

pay_first_then_login_flow.step_1_guest_clicks_payment: VERIFIED - Payment button opens Razorpay checkout without requiring login
pay_first_then_login_flow.step_2_razorpay_checkout: VERIFIED - Razorpay modal appears with correct price and payment options
pay_first_then_login_flow.step_4_redirect_to_login: CODE VERIFIED - Frontend stores pending_payment in sessionStorage and redirects to auth.emergentagent.com
pay_first_then_login_flow.step_5_activate_after_login: CODE VERIFIED - AuthCallback component calls /api/payment/activate-pending after successful login
pay_first_then_login_flow.note: Full end-to-end flow cannot be automated due to Razorpay 3rd party checkout. All individual components verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 verified the 'Pay First, Then Login' guest payment flow. All three guest payment endpoints are working: /api/payment/guest/create-order (no auth), /api/payment/guest/verify (no auth), /api/payment/activate-pending (requires auth). Frontend pricing section displays correctly with billing toggle. Razorpay checkout opens for guest users. The full flow (payment -> login -> activation) cannot be fully automated due to Razorpay 3rd party checkout, but all individual components are verified.
